name: Texas
notes: Per-county sums equal the SOS certified statewide totals exactly for pres2024 (11,388,674), sen_prev (11,144,040) and turnout2022 (8,102,908); Texas has no separate statewide-only (UOCAVA) bucket - overseas ballots are counted in the voter's county.
turnout2022 is governor total votes, not ballots cast (see sources).

sources.note: 2024 November 5th General Election, County-by-County Canvass Report (official); statewide from https://results.texas-election.com/static/data/Reports/49664/OfficialCanvassReport.xlsx. other = Oliver (LIB) 68,557 + Stein (GRE) 82,701 + certified write-ins 8,569.

2020 November 3rd General Election, U.S. Senator, County-by-County Canvass Report (official); statewide from https://results.texas-election.com/static/data/Reports/44144/OfficialCanvassReport.xlsx. other = McKennon (LIB) 209,722 + Collins (GRE) 81,893 + write-in 678.

Total votes for Governor, 2022 November 8th General Election (official county canvass). The SOS does not publish total ballots cast per county; its published 2022 turnout (8,102,908, https://www.sos.state.tx.us/elections/historical/70-92.shtml) and its results-site county 'votes cast' are this same governor total.

TLC Capitol Data Portal 2022 General 'Voter Data' VTD-level Turnout (ballots cast) sums to 8,143,047 statewide, 40,139 (+0.50%) above the governor total; compiled from county precinct returns, not the state canvass.
